support.request_quote: Find a channel with the smallest number of messages, and add all users who are not already in the channel to that channel
support.reason: Alice is a source user and is initially a member of channels including 'random', which is the channel with the smallest number of messages (1 message). The obligation requires that Alice is a member of the least-message channel 'random'.
